title: Juicy Smoky Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A fresh and flavorful Syrian dish featuring passion fruit pulp and smoky binchotan-charcoal, perfect for a low-sodium diet. This recipe is a twist on traditional Syrian kebabs with a sweet and tangy passion fruit glaze.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, using the binchotan charcoal for a smoky flavor.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
While the kebabs are cooking, mix the passion fruit pulp with a little water to thin it out.
Brush the passion fruit glaze onto the kebabs during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with a side of quinoa or couscous for a filling meal.
